rows.definition: RenderSlack (internal/sidecar/render.go) materializes a sidecar Pane as a Slack Block Kit payload ([]any of blocks), walking the same Sections() sequence its sibling RenderText walks so terminal and Slack carry the identical core-field order by construction.
rows.distinction: The Slack Block Kit materializer over a sidecar Pane - NOT RenderText (the sibling that materializes the same Pane as a terminal string) and NOT renderSlackRefresh / renderSlackWalk (cmd/fak/slack_refresh.go account-refresh output helpers that are unrelated to the sidecar pane).

rows.definition: SessionRows (internal/sidecar/sidecar.go) is the []SessionRow slice on the sidecar Inputs bundle carrying the collected fleet-session census rows into foldSessions, which folds them with the Sessions PlaneInput status into the rendered Sessions plane.
rows.distinction: The plural input slice of collected session census rows - NOT SessionRow (the singular row element type it holds) and NOT Sessions (the PlaneInput measurement-status for the same plane) and NOT tuiSessionRow (the terminal-overview render struct).
